places.name: CSU Spur
places.why: Completely free and open to the public — mock vet clinic, play kitchen, water table, and hands-on spots across three buildings; feels like a children's museum without the price. 2nd Saturdays add extra activities (Days.in.denver monthly favorite).
places.hours: Mon–Fri 9am–5pm; 2nd Saturdays 10am–2pm; closed other Sat & Sun
places.toddler_notes: Great for ~20 months: indoor play kitchen, water table, mock vet. Free year-round (except Stock Show grounds fee).

places.name: Denver Zoo
places.why: Days.in.denver June feature (130th anniversary programming) and fall Boo at the Zoo — classic toddler outing with stroller paths and animal viewing. Oct 8–9: Days.in.denver, Colorado Mama Life, and Little Rad Adventure all posted Boo at the Zoo (nine candy stations, friendly cryptid characters, new Wild Fall Market). CKAR's Oct 8 playground list also names Wild Village at the zoo. Days.in.denver's Oct 9 post: new this year is a Fall Market at the start of the Boo at the Zoo trail; arrive around 5:30 while it's still light. CKAR Oct 14 reel: going early while it's still light out works best with little kids (candy stations, carved pumpkins, Fall Market). CKE Oct 16 reel: Boo at the Zoo has 9 trick-or-treat stations, Animal Ambassador encounters, costumed characters, and crafts; remaining dates Oct 23–25 and 30, 4:30–9pm; ages 2 and under free; Oct 31 is a special sensory-friendly evening; timed tickets can sell out.

places.name: Apex & Enchanted Forest Loop (Apex Park)

places.why: Chanel's pick. A popular foothills loop: up Apex Trail along a little creek, then through the Enchanted Forest, where Jeffco Open Space says a dense forest gives shade on the park's west end. Watch for elk and fall color.

places.toddler_notes: Small lot fills; park at Tom Watson Park across 63rd St. Crusher-fines and gravel path, so a sturdy stroller works best (a few short rocky slopes on the west side). Expect lots of dogs, some off-leash.
places.hike: 1.2–1.3 mi easy loop · ~26–47 ft gain · stroller yes (sturdy, gravel sections)
places.drive_note: ~40 min drive from W 64th Ave & Ward Rd, Arvada, CO 80004 (~19.2 mi straight-line)

links.label: Colorado Mama Life Morrison Nature Center reel (Oct 18)

places.hours: Grounds sunrise–sunset; check nature center building hours

places.name: FlyteCo Tower
places.why: Colorado Kids Explore Oct 13 sponsored reel: indoor family entertainment with bowling, arcade, outdoor mini golf, and lawn/board games. Wed 3–8pm kids 12 & under free pasta with $15+ adult entrée; free mini golf that Wed window if you follow @flytecotower and show proof; Tue–Fri 3–6pm 50% off pizza/arcade. Tower tour is ages 10+ (separate).
places.hours: Closed Mon; typically Tue–Thu 11am–10pm, Fri–Sat 11am–11pm, Sun 11am–9pm (confirm on site)
places.cost: Pay-for-play + dining; Wed kids pasta deal
places.toddler_notes: Best as indoor rainy-day / food + light play; not a pure toddler venue. Tower tour not for under 10.
places.drive_note: ~25 min drive from W 64th Ave & Ward Rd, Arvada, CO 80004 (~13.6 mi straight-line)

places.name: DreamLab at Longmont Museum
places.why: Colorado Mama Life Oct 12 reel: permanent hands-on children's exhibit (DreamLab in Lila's Children's Gallery) with playful spaces like a dragon castle and crystal cave. Opens with a free grand reopening celebration Oct 17. Not the Girl Scout DreamLab in Denver Lowry.

places.toddler_notes: Hands-on children's gallery built for little explorers; permanent exhibit after the Oct 17 reopening.

places.name: Ridgeview Heights Park (new playground)
places.address: Kohl St & Hemlock Way / Iris St, Broomfield, CO 80021
places.why: Colorado Kids Are Rad Oct 18 reel: brand-new Broomfield playground (replaced in Broomfield's 2026 Playground Replacement Program) with lots of climbing, a mix of rubber surfacing and wood chips. Meagan said her 3-year-old loved it but her 1-year-old was not so into it, and some areas have bigger drop-offs.

places.name: Red Rocks Trading Post Trail
places.address: Trading Post, 17900 Trading Post Rd, Morrison, CO 80465
places.why: Colorado Kids Are Rad Oct 16 reel: Red Rocks isn't just for concerts. The Trading Post Trail loop winds through the red rock formations; steep, rocky sections but doable with little hikers. Pop into the Trading Post afterward for the little nature exhibits. Free.
places.source: Colorado Kids Are Rad (@coloradokidsarerad) Instagram reel 2026-10-16; Denver Mountain Parks

links.label: CKAR Red Rocks Trading Post reel (Oct 16)

places.hours: Park opens 1 hour before sunrise, closes 1 hour after sunset
places.toddler_notes: Bring the carrier rather than the stroller: packed dirt, stairs, and rocky stretches. Trails can be icy in winter. Restrooms at the Trading Post.

places.drive_note: ~25 min drive from W 64th Ave & Ward Rd, Arvada, CO 80004 (~10.8 mi straight-line)

places.name: Space DNVR (Paint on the Walls)
places.address: 3810 Pierce St, Suite C, Wheat Ridge, CO 80033

They tried the Paint on the Walls + Story Time class; per spacednvr.com, Little Creators sessions are a 2-hour drop-in window with story time at 10:30am, toys for free play, and outside snacks welcome.

places.name: Junkyard Social Club (Boulder)

places.name: Westminster Station Nature Play Park

places.name: McKay Lake Park (nature play area)
places.why: Colorado Kids Are Rad Oct 22 post listed it among their 6 favorite fall playgrounds. Nature play area with tunnels to crawl through, slides, a tiny stream, and bike ramps near McKay Lake.
